name: s451
signature: void s451(int *a, const int *b, const int *c, int n)

contract.execution: One execution of the original repetition-loop body, including local setup.
contract.aliasing: Distinct array arguments must have non-overlapping storage, matching the original globals. No restrict qualifier is added.
contract.arithmetic: Every evaluated signed arithmetic expression must be representable as int. Signed overflow is not defined as wraparound.
contract.memory: All array arguments are valid initialized buffers, also when n=0. No alignment beyond int alignment is required.
contract.notes: Mixed numeric kernel: choose the original double sin/cos branch; convert integer arguments to double, add in double, then truncate the sum toward zero to int. Requires libm; no float-trig or fast-math substitution.

numeric_adaptation.output_conversion: truncate the double sum toward zero to int, not each term separately
numeric_adaptation.environment: same conforming libm and default floating-point environment; no fast-math; errno and floating-point exception flags are outside the observable interface

adaptations: remove harness and execute one computational repetition
select double sin/cos branch; integer storage with double intermediate sum and final int truncation

experiment_caveats.aggregate_policy: report separately; do not silently pool with ordinary integer kernels

testing.description: Integer-storage inputs include [-3,3], +/-1000, INT_MIN, and INT_MAX; libm receives exact binary64 conversions and the sum is truncated to int.
